headline: Apple Pay launches in India with limited bank support
summary: Apple Pay has launched in India, but at launch it only supports cards from Axis Bank, as some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting it initially.

claims.statement: Apple Pay has launched in India.

sources.quote: Apple Pay finally launches in India after years on the sidelines
Apple Pay is now available in India

claims.statement: At launch, Apple Pay in India only supports Axis Bank cards, with other major banks not yet participating.

sources.quote: it only supports cards by Axis Bank for now
Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially
